reuse.why: Routes every scheduled-amount site (preview, posting, action sync, forecast, templates, API model, UI lists) through the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint copies and leaves the planning rule in one private getPlannedAmount behind getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the tolerance comes from shared/rules.ts, and the API field is derived in api-models.ts's toExternal.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps; the extra APIScheduleListEntity type and three release notes are reasonable but add some surface.

maintainability.why: One definition for all paths is easy to own; inserting op before the existing inverse positional parameter makes the signature easier to misuse.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an op parameter (ahead of inverse) and getPlannedAmount an isapprox branch; both express the real input variation, and all consumers call the helper.
